name: mixed_holdings_default
description: Real, default multi-round sequence: mixes both real DK holdings that trigger the holdings-correction path (SOUN, KTOS), a plain non-holding ticker (IONQ), a genuine follow-up question referencing the prior answer rather than naming a new ticker, and a final fresh ticker after several prior turns (RGTI). This is the exact sequence used to find and verify the fix for the double-yield bug (16422cca) and the cross-turn-contamination false positive found while building this harness. All ticker turns use real, in-training tickers, so a real, explicit expect_tool_call: true is asserted for each -- these should reliably call lookup_ticker.

turns.note: real DK holding -- triggers the holdings-correction path
not a real DK holding -- plain lookup
real DK holding -- triggers the holdings-correction path again

turns.message: Is that price up or down from what you just told me?
turns.note: genuine follow-up, not a new ticker -- should be answerable from context alone
final fresh ticker after several prior turns
